purpose: Define the evidence inputs, model boundaries and promotion gates for full 14-head VX4800 photometric system validation after an exact three-role photometry set becomes eligible.
sceneRequirements: controlled per-head aim vectors or target definitions
controlled surface locations and normals for evaluated targets
documented surface reflectance/material assumptions where interreflection is evaluated
documented obstruction model including relevant canopy/sculpture geometry when occlusion is evaluated
documented Radiance/toolchain version and command parameters
metricsRequiringReleasedAcceptanceCriter: illuminance or irradiance on named target surfaces
spill light on named non-target regions

validationLayers.name: direct-light distribution
validationLayers.note: Use exact source photometry and controlled head poses to verify direct distribution before adding scene complexity.

validationLayers.name: fixture/sculpture occlusion
validationLayers.note: Include relevant fixed canopy and butterfly-field obstruction geometry only from controlled/reviewed geometry sources.

validationLayers.name: architectural interreflection
validationLayers.note: Requires controlled/documented reflectance assumptions; do not infer finish reflectance from Blender shaders.

validationLayers.name: aim/setout sensitivity
validationLayers.note: Test released construction/commissioning tolerances rather than arbitrary perturbations.

rules: No system-level pass is permitted before acceptance criteria are released.
Synthetic IES or SPD may exercise the software pipeline only and cannot close product gates.
Presentation or Blender light positions/aiming are not engineering input unless promoted through controlled design change.
A single idealized scene does not establish tolerance robustness.
Photometric simulation does not replace site commissioning measurements where those are required by the released project plan.
Product photometry approval remains a separate controlled release decision after system validation evidence is reviewed.
